# JGusew Computers

> Practical, plain-English technology help for everyday people and small businesses, run by Jehiah Gusew from Sunbury, Victoria, Australia. Help is delivered by email — no phone queues, no call-outs. Paid work is always scoped and quoted before it starts; nothing is charged without the customer's approval. AI may help draft, but a real person (Jehiah) reviews everything before it goes out.

Key facts:
- Contact: hello@jgusewcomputers.com (email only, reply within 1 working day)
- Location: Sunbury, VIC, Australia (service available online Australia-wide)
- Pricing: quoted up front before any work begins; enquiries are free and without obligation
- Trust model: "AI drafts. Jehiah reviews." — no automated replies, no bots

## Services

- [Computer help](https://jgusewcomputers.com/services/computer-help.html): Slow computers, viruses, crashes, repair-vs-replace advice
- [Website help](https://jgusewcomputers.com/services/website-help.html): Fast static websites with no monthly CMS fees
- [Forms and enquiry systems](https://jgusewcomputers.com/services/forms-enquiry-systems.html): Contact and intake forms delivered to email
- [Email account cleanup](https://jgusewcomputers.com/services/email-account-cleanup.html): Inbox cleanup, spam reduction, account organisation
- [Small business tech advice](https://jgusewcomputers.com/services/small-business-tech-advice.html): Practical reviews of small-business technology
- [AI automation](https://jgusewcomputers.com/services/ai-automation.html): Free-first workflow automation without automating sensitive judgement
